direct_beta_definition_at_each_h: abs((d_m(beta=+h)-d_m(beta=-h))/(2*h)) at exact requested target k inserted via CLASS k_output_values
coordinate_h_spread_definition: max pairwise relative difference among the five pre-registered direct-beta responses at a fixed (z,k)

pre_registered_decision.h_dependent_conditioning_strongly_suppor: Exact target-k binding and invariants pass; matched-control max h-spread is < 0.001; and at least 75 percent of unique failing coordinates have h-spread >= 0.001.
pre_registered_decision.h_stable_direct_response: Exact target-k binding and invariants pass; matched-control max h-spread is < 0.001; and max h-spread over unique failing coordinates is < 0.001.
pre_registered_decision.mixed_h_dependence: Exact target-k binding and invariants pass and matched controls pass, but neither strong h-dependence nor full h-stability rule is met.
pre_registered_decision.inconclusive: Any source/probe identity mismatch, nonfinite response, duplicate-coordinate disagreement, exact target-k binding mismatch > 1e-12, or matched-control max h-spread >= 0.001 makes the audit diagnostic-inconclusive.

authorized_next_stage_only_after_termina: Use V0.5 only to choose a separately frozen numerical repair/validation path; do not promote a scientific gate directly from this audit.
